title: Analyzing Sentiment Polarity Reduction in News Presentation through Contextual Perturbation and Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the reduction of aspect-specific sentiment polarity and emotional language in political news sentences. The bias mitigation is performed using adversarial contextual perturbations (via BERT) and zero-shot prompting (via ChatGPT), and is measured using an NLI-based RoBERTa sentiment classifier to track the increase in predicted neutrality. Additional evaluation includes entailment models for content preservation, perplexity for fluency, and human evaluation.
